Page Layout

Shell & Sidebar Layout

모든 Shopcord 페이지에 적용되는 레이아웃 구조. Shell → Sidebar + Main → Tab Bar + Content 순서.

Layout Anatomy

shell padding: 16px all sides
Sidebar
256px
← 16px →
Account
Company
Billing

← 32px →
Page Title

Spacing Spec

Element Value Reference point
.shell padding 16px All sides, viewport
.sidebar width 256px Fixed, includes border
.shell gap 0px Sidebar ↔ main column
.main padding (H) 16px Tab pill left from sidebar right
.main gap 48px Tab bar ↔ content area
.content padding (H) 32px From tab pill left edge (= 48px from sidebar right)
.tab-list height 64px Full-width pill, border-radius 16px

CSS

/* Shell */
.shell { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; padding: 16px; gap: 0; align-items: flex-start; }

/* Sidebar */
.sidebar {
  width: 256px; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
  position: sticky; top: 16px; height: calc(100vh - 32px);
  overflow-y: auto; align-self: stretch;
}

/* Main column */
.main {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  gap: 48px;            /* tab bar ↔ content */
  padding: 0 16px 48px; /* H: tab pill 16px from sidebar */
}

/* Tab bar — full-width pill, NO border-bottom */
.tabs-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.tab-list {
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  width: 100%; height: 64px;
  background: var(--surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 0 16px;
}
.tab-btn { padding: 6px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
.tab-btn:hover:not(.active) { background: none; }
.tab-btn.active { background: var(--accent-sub); color: var(--text-1); }

/* Content — 32px from tab pill left = 48px from sidebar right */
.content { flex: 1; padding: 0 32px; max-width: 1024px; width: 100%; }
